dct_description_sm: Image data were collected to reveal the following: - Timing and intensity of snow melt on the glacier. - Development and evolution of glacier surface drainage networks. - Accumulation of surface melt-water in supra-glacial lakes. - Timing and duration of supra-glacial lake draining events. - Potential links between supra- and en-glacial drainage networks. - Iceberg calving activity at the terminus of the glacier.
dct_title_s: Glaciodyn (Canada) IPY Project: Time-lapse photography data of supraglacial lakes and glacier terminus, Belcher Glacier, 2007
